filesystem_policy: read-only review worktree by default; test-only branch only when coordinator assigns
allowed_operations: read requirements repository draft pull requests and test logs
run tests and builds in local CI or private preview
create bug reports and test reports
prohibited_operations: close significant bugs without reproducible evidence
weaken requirements to make tests pass
use real customer data or secrets
required_output: Bug List with severity and reproduction steps
approval_gate: coordinator accepts evidence; QA cannot approve production
